title: Ukrainian-Style Oven Broiled Tomatoes
description: A simple and flavorful side dish that combines the sweetness of tomatoes with the richness of Ukrainian spices.
instructions: Cut the tomatoes in half and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the tomatoes and sprinkle with parsley, dill, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and sugar.
Broil the tomatoes in the oven for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are tender and lightly charred.
Remove the tomatoes from the oven and let them cool slightly.
Serve the tomatoes warm, garnished with additional parsley and dill if desired.
